stem.text: A large excess of magnesium ribbon is added to dilute hydrochloric acid and the volume of hydrogen gas produced is measured as the reaction proceeds. The reaction is exothermic.

stem.alt: Graph of total volume in cm3 against time in s: a steep rise between points P and Q, then levelling off towards R. P, Q and R are labelled on the curve.

stem.text: Which row explains the changes in the rate of reaction between points P and Q and between points Q and R?

A.text: the reaction temperature is increasing; the acid concentration is falling

B.text: the reaction temperature is increasing; the magnesium has been used up

C.text: magnesium's surface area is decreasing; the acid concentration is falling

D.text: magnesium's surface area is decreasing; the magnesium has been used up

B: the magnesium has been used up
D: the magnesium has been used up
